thought.text: The container is marked unhealthy, but HTTP endpoints respond 200. The HEALTHCHECK uses `curl`, which is likely not installed in the runtime image. Let me verify this hypothesis.

reasoning_content:
The healthcheck reports unhealthy, but the endpoints respond 200. The HEALTHCHECK uses `curl`, and curl is NOT installed in the runtime python:3.13-slim image (curl isn't in the apt install list). So the healthcheck fails because curl is missing. That's a Dockerfile issue, not app issue. The app itself is accessible. Let me verify curl missing in the container.

This is a known flaw - healthcheck CMD curl but curl not installed. But installation is successful since app works. Let me confirm.

action.command: docker exec deployment-streamlit-pipeline-1 sh -c 'which curl || echo "curl NOT installed"; echo "---healthcheck test---"; curl --fail http://localhost:8501/_stcore/health; echo "exit:$?"' 2>&1; echo "===inspect health==="; docker inspect --format '{{json .State.Health}}' deployment-streamlit-pipeline-1 2>&1 | head -c 1500
